info.title: EventPlug API
info.description: All /api/v1 endpoints require an Auth0 access token (Authorization: Bearer <token>) and the X-Org-Id header. IDs are UUIDs, enums are strings, money is a decimal string (e.g. "1250.00"). Lists return { items, total }; errors return { code, message, fieldErrors? }.

post.summary: Planner on the owning team, or an admin. 409 if the event already has that category type.

delete.summary: 409 while the category still has expenses.

get.summary: Allocated, spent and remaining per category, plus each team's share from expense splits.
Expenses for an event, newest first. Optional categoryId filter.

post.summary: Planner on the owning team, or an admin. Status starts as Pending.

delete.summary: Splits are removed with it. 409 if approvals reference the expense.

post.summary: Assign another team to the event. Planner on the owning team, or an admin.

delete.summary: Unassign a team. The owning team cannot be removed; 409 if the team has expense splits on this event.

get.summary: Events in the organisation, soonest first. 'from'/'to' return events overlapping that date range. teamId returns events that team is assigned to.

post.summary: Create an event owned by one team. Caller must be a Planner on that team (or an admin).

patch.summary: Update an event. Planner on the owning team, or an admin.

delete.summary: Delete an event with its teams, guests, run sheet and budget categories. 409 if vendors, AI drafts or expenses still reference it.

get.summary: Guests for an event, by name. Optional rsvpStatus filter.

post.summary: Add a guest. Planner on the owning team, or an admin. 409 if the email is already on the guest list.
Add up to 1000 guests at once (e.g. from a directory upload). Valid rows are saved; duplicates are skipped and invalid rows are reported.

get.summary: The signed-in user, their organisation and their team memberships.
The organisation selected by the X-Org-Id header.
Run sheet items ordered by day, sortOrder, then start time. Optional day filter.

post.summary: Add an item. Planner on the owning team, or an admin.
Add a user to the team. Admin, or a Planner on this team.

patch.summary: Change a member's role. Admin, or a Planner on this team. Non-admins cannot demote the last Planner.

delete.summary: Remove a member. Admin, a Planner on this team, or the member themselves. Non-admins cannot remove the last Planner.

get.summary: Teams in the organisation. Set mine=true for only the teams the caller belongs to.

delete.summary: Delete a team and its memberships. Admin only. 409 if any event, expense split or approval still references it.

get.summary: Users in the organisation. Optional search on name/email and filter by team.

patch.summary: Users can rename themselves; admins can rename anyone and change OrgRole.

get.summary: The organisation's vendor directory, by name. Optional category filter and name search (q).

post.summary: Admin, or a Planner on any team.

patch.summary: Admin, or a Planner on any team.

delete.summary: Admin only. 409 while the vendor is linked to an event or used by an expense.

post.summary: Link a vendor to the event. Planner on the owning team, or an admin. 409 if already linked.

patch.summary: Change the vendor's status for this event.

delete.summary: Unlink a vendor. 409 if quote requests exist for this link.

Bearer.description: Auth0 access token issued for the API audience.

OrgId.description: UUID of the organisation the request is scoped to.
OrgId.name: X-Org-Id
